idea_text: Nvidia will beat earning next quarter
note: Trial based on two manually reviewed drivers from the current connections. Annual revenue and capital spending are indirect inputs; this is not an earnings-beat probability. Other linked revenue and capex estimates are not counted separately. History applies this current basket retrospectively.

drivers.question: Can sustained sequential growth through calendar 2026 lift NVIDIA FY2027 total revenue into which range?
drivers.label: Revenue outlook
drivers.reason: Use total revenue as the broad revenue representative; segment and product revenue cards overlap this driver. A stronger business revenue score supports this positive earnings idea, but is not a comparison with quarterly consensus.

drivers.question: Will combined 2026 capital expenditure by the top five cloud providers and hyperscalers approach or exceed $700 billion?
drivers.label: AI infrastructure spending
drivers.reason: Use the current-year top-five capex thesis as the demand backdrop representative. The other capex and financing cards overlap this backdrop or cover a later period. Higher spending is assumed supportive for this trial.
